user.title: HACS Energy Scheduler
user.description: Configure the energy scheduler integration. Select the sensors for energy prices and the inverter mode entity.

data_description.price_buy_sensor: Sensor providing buy energy prices with 'data' attribute
data_description.price_sell_sensor: Sensor providing sell energy prices with 'data' attribute
data_description.inverter_mode_entity: Input select entity controlling inverter modes
data_description.ev_stop_condition: Condition to trigger stop for EV charging schedules (uses Home Assistant conditions)

default_mode.title: Default Mode
default_mode.description: Select the primary inverter mode used for PV Charge and Self-Consume First actions.

data_description.default_mode: Fallback operating mode if no Grid Only mode is configured

abort.no_inverter_modes: No modes found in the inverter mode entity

basic.title: Basic Settings
basic.description: Configure price sensors and inverter entity.

data_description.inverter_export_surplus_switch: Optional switch/input_boolean that enables grid export on your inverter. Turned OFF automatically when the sell price is at or below the Minimum Sell Price, to avoid giving energy away.
data_description.inverter_pv_input_switch: Optional switch/input_boolean that disables PV input on your inverter (e.g. a helper that flips the inverter's max-PV-power between 0 and full). Turned OFF automatically during negative-price charge and Paid Import hours so the home/battery actually pull from the paid grid instead of being silently covered by free PV. When configured, takes precedence over the dedicated 'Charge Battery (Grid Only)' and 'Paid Import' modes.
data_description.ev_stop_condition: Condition to trigger stop for EV charging schedules (uses Home Assistant conditions)

battery.title: Battery Optimizer Settings
battery.description: Configure battery parameters for the energy optimizer.

data_description.battery_soc_sensor: Sensor providing battery state of charge (%)
data_description.battery_min_soc: Never discharge below this SOC level
data_description.battery_cost: Purchase cost of the battery (for cycle cost calculation)
data_description.battery_cycles: Expected total battery cycles (for wear calculation)
data_description.min_sell_price: Don't sell below this price (protects against wear exceeding revenue)
data_description.min_discharge_energy: Skip discharge slots below this energy amount (avoids unnecessary inverter mode switches)

forecast.title: PV Forecast & Consumption
forecast.description: Configure solar forecast and consumption settings.

data_description.pv_forecast_sensor: Solcast or Forecast.Solar sensor for today's PV production forecast
data_description.pv_forecast_tomorrow_sensor: Sensor for tomorrow's PV production forecast (enables 48h planning)
data_description.avg_consumption: Average hourly power consumption of your home (fallback)
data_description.max_grid_power: Maximum power available from the grid (limits concurrent charging)
data_description.consumption_sensor: Cumulative kWh sensor for building hourly consumption profile from history
data_description.ev_charger_consumption_sensor: EV charger energy or power sensor — subtracted from consumption profile to separate home vs EV usage
data_description.load_power_sensor: Real-time total house load sensor (kW) for breaker protection — must include EV consumption
data_description.breaker_power_limit: Main breaker limit (kW). EV charging throttled when load approaches this. 0 = disabled
data_description.pv_production_sensor: Today-energy sensor (kWh, resets at midnight) used to compare actual PV against the forecast for already-elapsed hours
data_description.pv_dynamic_correction_enabled: When enabled, the integration scales the remainder of today's forecast by the actual/forecast ratio of past hours (active after ≥2 kWh forecast accumulated)
data_description.pv_confidence_factor: Manual multiplier on top of the forecast (100% = pass-through). Useful as a fallback for non-Solcast providers or as extra conservatism for tomorrow

data_description.ev_soc_sensor: Sensor providing EV state of charge (%)
data_description.ev_target_soc: Target SOC to charge EV to
data_description.ev_connected_sensor: Sensor indicating if EV is connected/plugged in
data_description.ev_ready_by: Time by which EV should be charged (optional)
data_description.priority_home_low_threshold: Below this SOC, home battery has priority over EV
data_description.priority_home_high_threshold: Above this SOC, EV can be charged alongside battery
data_description.priority_ev_high_threshold: Above this SOC, EV is considered sufficiently charged
data_description.ev_charge_entity: Switch entity to start/stop EV charging (if empty, fallback sensors are created)
data_description.ev_amps_entity: Number entity to set charging current (if empty, fallback sensor is created)
data_description.ev_min_charge_amps: Minimum charging current (charger stops below this)

modes.title: Inverter Mode Mapping
modes.description: Map optimizer actions to your inverter modes.

data_description.default_mode: Primary mode used for PV Charge and Self-Consume First actions
data_description.mode_charge_battery: Mode for charging battery from grid
data_description.mode_charge_ev_and_battery: Mode for charging both EV and battery
data_description.mode_sell: Mode for selling/discharging battery to grid
data_description.mode_sell_solar_only: Mode for selling only solar production
data_description.mode_grid_only: Mode to use grid only (don't discharge battery). Used for Paid Import hours; combine with the PV Input switch (Basic Settings) to get paid for grid imports during negative-price hours.
data_description.mode_self_consume: Mode to consume all energy locally (don't export to grid)

error.home_low_must_be_less_than_high: Home low threshold must be less than high threshold
error.ev_min_amps_must_be_less_than_max: Minimum charge amps must be less than maximum

soc_limit_type.name: SOC Limit Type
soc_limit_type.description: auto: detect from current SOC, max: charge up to limit, min: discharge down to limit

full_hour.name: Full Hour
full_hour.description: Run action for the entire hour

minutes.name: Minutes

run_optimization.name: Run Optimization
run_optimization.description: Analyze prices and PV forecast to create an optimal schedule

hours_ahead.name: Planning Horizon
hours_ahead.description: Number of hours to plan ahead (12-48)

ev_charge_now.name: EV Charge Now
ev_charge_now.description: Start manual EV charging at maximum amps
